prompt:
A sprite sheet of 12 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 4 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) small wooden-framed window with open checked curtains, the glass shows a deep blue night sky (seen straight on, as hung on a wall); 2) framed oil painting of a green hilly landscape in a gilded wooden frame (seen straight on, hung on a wall); 3) short wooden wall shelf with plates, a jug and cups standing on it (seen straight on); 4) bundles of dried herbs, garlic braids and chili peppers hanging from a wooden peg rail; 5) iron wall sconce with a single white candle (unlit wick), mounted on a small back plate; 6) round wooden shield with two crossed swords behind it, a wall trophy; 7) old sea chart / nautical map pinned to the wall, parchment with coastlines and a compass rose; 8) small woven wall tapestry with a red and gold pattern hanging from a wooden rod; 9) copper pots, a ladle and frying pans hanging from hooks on a wall rail; 10) mounted deer antlers on a wooden plaque; 11) wooden ship's steering wheel mounted on the wall; 12) blacksmith's tool rack on the wall: hammers, tongs and files hanging on pegs.
Scale: each wall decoration is about 20-30 art pixels wide and 18-26 art pixels tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. These are flat wall decorations seen straight on (front view), meant to be drawn onto the back wall of a room.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Wall decorations for a cosy medieval-fantasy village interior.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Generate a single transparent-background sprite sheet of exactly 12 DISTINCT small medieval fantasy interior WALL DECORATIONS in a precisely aligned 3 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS grid, reading left-to-right and top-to-bottom, with ample fully transparent padding between every silhouette and around every outer edge. Front-on elevation view for wall hangings (not isometric floor objects), with subtly visible top edges and front surfaces where appropriate. Row 1: (1) wooden-framed window, open checked curtains and deep blue night sky in the glass; (2) gilded wooden frame holding oil painting of green hills; (3) short wooden wall shelf, with plates, jug and cups. Row 2: (4) wooden peg rail holding dried herbs, garlic braids, chili peppers; (5) iron wall sconce on backplate holding ONE white candle with black UNLIT wick, no flame; (6) wooden round shield mounted in front of TWO crossed swords. Row 3: (7) aged parchment nautical sea map pinned on wall with coastlines and compass rose; (8) red and gold patterned woven wall tapestry hung on a wooden rod; (9) copper pots, ladle and frying pans hanging from wall hooks and rail. Row 4: (10) mounted deer antlers on wooden plaque; (11) wooden ship steering wheel mounted on wall; (12) blacksmith wall tool rack holding hammers, tongs and files on pegs. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Each prop approximately 20–30 native art pixels in width and 18–26 native art pixels in height; draw using a uniform consistent pixel grid, each visible pixel a clean hard-edged square approximately 6–8 final image pixels across, deliberate pixel clusters 3–10 pixels, crisp silhouette. Absolutely no smoothing, anti-aliasing, blur, texture, noise, dithering, or checkerboard patterns (except checks on the first curtains). Tasteful rich earthy colors, hue-shifted ramps 4–6 shades per material: purple-red saturated shadows, warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left illumination, base colors only, no cast shadows, no glowing or flames, no pools of light, no vignette. All twelve props standalone, fully visible, not overlapping or touching, no ground, no labels, no numbers, no text. TRUE FULL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY everywhere outside the props, NOT a simulated checkerboard, NOT white or colored background.
